title: City airports keep San Diego soaring!
description:
From Kearny Mesa to Otay Mesa, our City airports keep San Diego soaring! ✈️

Montgomery Gibbs Executive Airport is one of the nation’s busiest general aviation hubs, while Brown Field Airport provides the first international access point closest to the U.S.–Mexico border. 

Both airports also serve as major economic drivers for the region. Two airports, one city, endless stories in the sky. 🌤️✨
